description: September 22 birthday meaning: Virgo or Libra cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, September 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Virgo or Libra. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a September 22 birthday
paragraphs: September 22 is a genuine cusp date: depending on year and time of birth, the Sun is either in the final degree of Virgo or has just entered Libra. Blending the two gives practicality with a feel for fairness and form. The master number 22, the builder, suits that mix, pointing towards ambitious, well-designed projects that serve many people at once.

By noon UTC on September 22, the Sun has normally reached roughly 29° of Virgo. That places the date in the Virgo decan that astrologers give to Venus, the third of three. Born around September 21 to September 23, close to the equinox, you sit between Virgo and Libra. Earth hands over to air, and practicality to partnership. The precise day and minute of the Sun's move into Libra changes with the year, so your actual sign depends on birth year, time and location, which a natal chart can resolve. Those who feel both influences are often described as refined and thoughtful: careful about details, invested in fairness and drawn to beauty that also works. Decisions may take time, because both signs like to get things right.

sections.heading: Numerology of the September 22 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same September 22 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 33 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: September 22 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 22 is the 265th day of the year (266th in a leap year). In most years Libra season is under way by September 23, 1 day after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 22 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. September 22 is also the birthday of Michael Faraday (1791), Andrea Bocelli (1958) and Ségolène Royal (1953).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 22?
faq.answer: September 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Virgo or Libra on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Virgo. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 22 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 33 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 22?
faq.answer: By September 22 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 22?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a September 22 birthday are Michael Faraday (1791), Andrea Bocelli (1958) and Ségolène Royal (1953). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
